trial.source: Local MediaMTX 1.21.1 with FFmpeg 9.0.2 H.264 testsrc2, 640x360 at 15 fps over TCP RTSP
trial.client: One 32x32 full-canvas tile, software decode, 320x180 macOS window
checks_per_sample: tile remains playing on source generation 1
output and decoded rates are each at least 5 fps
last output frame age is at most 4 seconds

limits: The output probe is upstream of the macOS display sink; displayed pixels and dropped display frames were not measured.
The local bridge was intentionally absent because the tile used a direct RTSP URL; the client logged expected WebSocket reconnection attempts during the soak.
The Homebrew GStreamer plugin scanner logged missing GI typelib libraries and duplicate GTK Objective-C classes at startup; decoded and output frames progressed normally.
This uninterrupted synthetic source trial does not cover physical display continuity, real Eufy cameras, sleep/wake, clean-host installation, or Apple Silicon.
Separate clean-binary recovery evidence covers two 45-second local RTSP publisher outages.
